title: Newhalo newsletter
description: A white sign-up band: a 64px heading on the left and, on the right, an outlined email field with its label set into the border, a consent checkbox with small underlined links, and a button that stays greyed out until the form is valid. The form parts fade in one after another.
notes: the button's disabled look is pure CSS (:has(:invalid)); no JavaScript needed
name: newhalo-newsletter

props.name: consent
props.description: the consent sentence next to the checkbox (may contain links)

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: the submit button's label; it stays greyed out until the email and the box are filled in
